exercises.title: Bài 1 · Seeing like a designer
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Graphic design is the art of communicating a message with images and text. Every design starts with a concept. Designers usually collect ideas on a mood board and draw several sketches before they open any software.

Good designs follow some basic principles. Contrast makes important elements stand out, and alignment keeps everything in order. Proximity groups related items together, while repetition creates a consistent style. A strong hierarchy shows the viewer where to look first, so the focal point is clear.

White space is also very important. Beginners often fill every empty area, but experienced designers know that space gives the eyes a rest. Minimalism, a style that uses few elements, is popular because it communicates the message quickly. At the moment, many studios are combining simple layouts with bold colors to attract a young audience.

content.q: Designers usually draw sketches before they open any software.
content.why: Đoạn 1: phác thảo trước khi mở phần mềm.

content.q: Contrast keeps everything in order.
content.why: Đoạn 2: **alignment** giữ trật tự; contrast làm yếu tố quan trọng nổi bật.

content.q: A strong hierarchy shows the viewer where to look first.
content.why: Đoạn 2: thứ bậc mạnh chỉ ra nơi nhìn đầu tiên.

content.q: Experienced designers fill every empty area.
content.why: Đoạn 3: người mới hay lấp đầy; người có kinh nghiệm biết khoảng trống giúp mắt nghỉ.

content.q: What is a mood board used for?
What does proximity do?
content.why: Đoạn 2: nhóm các mục liên quan lại gần nhau.
opts: Makes all items the same size

content.q: Why is minimalism popular?
content.why: Đoạn 3: truyền đạt thông điệp nhanh.

content.q: What are many studios doing at the moment?
content.why: Đoạn 3: kết hợp bố cục đơn giản với màu đậm.
opts: Combining simple layouts with bold colors

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Choosing the right typeface
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Typography is the art of arranging type so that it is readable and attractive. The first decision is the typeface. Serif fonts, such as Times New Roman, are traditional and are often used in books. Sans serif fonts, such as Helvetica, look cleaner and are usually easier to read on screens. Display fonts are more decorative, so they are best for large titles, not for long paragraphs.

Next, the designer sets the size, leading and line length. A line that is too long is harder to follow than a short one, and tight leading makes text feel crowded. Kerning improves the space between individual letters, which is especially important in a logo.

Finally, the designer builds the layout on a grid with columns, margins and gutters. A clear hierarchy of headings, subheadings and body text is the best way to guide readers through a page.

content.q: Serif fonts are often used in books.
content.why: Đoạn 1: chữ có chân thường dùng trong sách.

content.q: Display fonts are the best choice for long paragraphs.
content.why: Đoạn 1: phông trang trí hợp tiêu đề lớn, không phải đoạn dài.

content.q: A very long line is easier to follow than a short one.
content.why: Đoạn 2: dòng quá dài khó theo dõi hơn dòng ngắn.

content.q: A grid with columns, margins and gutters helps build the layout.
content.why: Đoạn 3: bố cục được dựng trên lưới.

content.q: Why are sans serif fonts popular on screens?
content.why: Đoạn 1: trông gọn và dễ đọc hơn trên màn hình.
opts: They are used only in books
They look cleaner and are usually easier to read

content.q: What does tight leading cause?
content.why: Đoạn 2: khoảng cách dòng chặt làm văn bản chật chội.

content.q: Why is kerning important in a logo?
content.why: Đoạn 2: kerning cải thiện khoảng cách giữa từng chữ cái.
opts: It improves the space between individual letters

content.q: What guides readers through a page?
content.why: Đoạn 3: thứ bậc tiêu đề rõ ràng dẫn dắt người đọc.
opts: A clear hierarchy of headings, subheadings and body text

exercises.title: Bài 1 · From screen to print
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Color is one of the most powerful tools in design. A color palette is usually chosen on the color wheel: complementary colors, which are opposite each other, create strong contrast. Hue, saturation and brightness can be adjusted to change the mood of a design.

Digital images are made in two main ways. Raster images consist of pixels, so they lose quality when they are enlarged. Vector graphics are built from mathematical paths, so logos are almost always saved as vectors. Designs for screens are created in RGB, while files for print are converted to CMYK before they are sent to the printer.

In professional software, each element is placed on a separate layer, and masks are used to hide parts of an image without deleting them. When the work is finished, the file is exported in a suitable format. JPEG files are compressed to make them smaller, and PNG files are used when a transparent background is needed.

content.q: Complementary colors are opposite each other on the color wheel.
content.why: Đoạn 1: màu bổ sung nằm đối diện nhau trên vòng tròn màu.

content.q: Raster images keep their quality when they are enlarged.
content.why: Đoạn 2: ảnh raster mất chất lượng khi phóng to.

content.q: Files for print are converted to CMYK.
content.why: Đoạn 2: tệp in được chuyển sang CMYK.

content.q: Masks delete parts of an image permanently.
content.why: Đoạn 3: mask ẩn một phần ảnh **mà không xóa**.

content.q: Why are logos usually saved as vectors?
content.why: Đoạn 2: vector tạo từ đường toán học nên không vỡ khi đổi kích thước.
opts: Vector graphics are built from mathematical paths
Vectors always have a transparent background

content.q: What is a mask used for?
content.why: Đoạn 3: ẩn một phần ảnh mà không xóa.
opts: To hide parts of an image without deleting them

content.q: Why are JPEG files compressed?
content.why: Đoạn 3: nén để giảm dung lượng.

content.q: Which format is used when a transparent background is needed?
content.why: Đoạn 3: PNG dùng khi cần nền trong suốt.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Working with a client
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
A project usually starts with a brief, in which the client explains the target audience, the goal, the budget and the deadline. The designer must read the brief carefully and should ask questions if anything is unclear. Then the designer prepares a proposal that describes the scope of work and the price.

Before work begins, both sides have to sign a contract. It must say how many revisions are included, because unlimited changes can destroy a freelancer's schedule. The client doesn't have to approve every sketch, but they should give clear feedback at each stage.

Designers must also respect copyright. They mustn't use a photo, a font or an illustration without a license. Many designers use royalty-free stock photos for this reason. Finally, the final files must follow the brand guidelines, and the designer has to send an invoice when the deliverables are accepted.

content.q: The brief explains the target audience, goal, budget and deadline.
content.why: Đoạn 1: brief nêu đối tượng, mục tiêu, ngân sách và hạn chót.

content.q: A contract should say how many revisions are included.
content.why: Đoạn 2: hợp đồng phải ghi số lần chỉnh sửa.

content.q: The client has to approve every sketch.
content.why: Đoạn 2: khách **không cần** duyệt từng bản phác (doesn't have to).

content.q: Designers may use any font without a license.
content.why: Đoạn 3: không được dùng ảnh, phông hay hình minh họa khi chưa có giấy phép.

content.q: What should a designer do if the brief is unclear?
content.why: Đoạn 1: nên đặt câu hỏi nếu có điểm chưa rõ.

content.q: Why must the contract state the number of revisions?
content.why: Đoạn 2: chỉnh sửa vô hạn phá vỡ lịch làm việc.
opts: Unlimited changes can destroy a freelancer's schedule

content.q: Why do many designers use royalty-free stock photos?
content.why: Đoạn 3: để tôn trọng bản quyền.

content.q: When does the designer send an invoice?
content.why: Đoạn 3: khi sản phẩm bàn giao được chấp nhận.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Making a short video
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Every video project begins with a script and a storyboard. The script contains the words that will be spoken, and the storyboard shows each shot as a drawing. If the team plans carefully, filming will be faster and cheaper.

During filming, the crew records footage with different camera angles. A close-up shows emotion, while a wide shot shows the setting. If the lighting is poor, the footage will look noisy, so crews often use extra lights. If a scene needs a different background, they film in front of a green screen.

In post-production, the editor arranges clips on the timeline and adds transitions, subtitles and motion graphics. If the editor had more time, he would add more sound effects, but the deadline is fixed. At the end, the audio is mixed, and the video is exported with a suitable codec for streaming.

content.q: A storyboard shows each shot as a drawing.
content.why: Đoạn 1: storyboard thể hiện từng cảnh quay bằng hình vẽ.

content.q: If the lighting is poor, the footage will look better.
content.why: Đoạn 2: ánh sáng kém làm đoạn phim bị nhiễu.

content.q: A green screen allows a different background to be used.
content.why: Đoạn 2: quay trước phông xanh để thay nền.

content.q: The editor adds subtitles during filming.
content.why: Đoạn 3: phụ đề được thêm ở khâu hậu kỳ.

content.q: What happens if the team plans carefully?
content.why: Đoạn 1: quay nhanh và rẻ hơn.

content.why: Đoạn 2: cận cảnh thể hiện cảm xúc.

content.why: Đoạn 3: thêm hiệu ứng âm thanh.

content.q: What is done at the end of post-production?
content.why: Đoạn 3: trộn âm thanh và xuất video.
opts: The audio is mixed and the video is exported

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Building a portfolio
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Last year, Mai graduated from a design school and began to look for her first job. She quickly understood that a strong portfolio is more important than a résumé. Over the past twelve months, she has created six projects, including a logo, a poster series and a mobile app.

For the app, she drew wireframes and then built an interactive prototype. She ran user testing with ten people and changed the navigation after she saw that many of them were confused. Since then, the usability of the app has improved a lot.

Mai has also written a short case study for each project. These explain the problem, the process and the result, and they show how she thinks. She shared the portfolio on social media, and a small agency invited her for an interview.

content.q: Mai graduated from design school last year.
content.why: Đoạn 1: cô tốt nghiệp năm ngoái.

content.q: She has created six projects over the past twelve months.
content.why: Đoạn 1: sáu dự án trong mười hai tháng qua.

content.q: She changed the logo after user testing.
content.why: Đoạn 2: cô thay đổi **phần điều hướng** sau khi thử nghiệm.

content.q: A large company invited her for an interview.
content.why: Đoạn 3: một agency **nhỏ** mời cô phỏng vấn.

content.q: What did Mai build for the app after the wireframes?
content.why: Đoạn 2: cô xây dựng bản mẫu tương tác.

content.q: Why did she change the navigation?
content.why: Đoạn 2: nhiều người thử nghiệm bị bối rối.
opts: The client asked for new colors
The file size was too large

content.q: What do the case studies show?
content.why: Đoạn 3: cho thấy cách cô tư duy.

content.q: How did the agency find her?
content.why: Đoạn 3: cô chia sẻ portfolio trên mạng xã hội.
opts: She sent a résumé by post
She shared her portfolio on social media
